plant_corn.look: a tall CORN / maize plant: an upright green stalk with long arching leaves and one or two yellow CORN COBS, distinctly TALLER than it is wide. Clearly corn.

plant_tomato.look: a mature TOMATO plant: a low leafy green bush with several round ripe RED TOMATOES hanging among the leaves. Clearly tomatoes (red).

plant_wheat.look: a clump of ripe golden WHEAT: several upright tan-GOLDEN stalks topped with bushy seed heads, dry straw colour. Clearly wheat, NOT green leafy.

plant_tomato_stage0.look: a tiny TOMATO SPROUT just emerging from dark tilled soil: one thin pale-green stem with TWO small round seed leaves. Tiny and delicate, mostly bare soil visible.

plant_tomato_stage1.look: a young TOMATO seedling: a short green stem with a few small jagged tomato leaves, NO fruit, NO flowers. Clearly a juvenile leafy plant.

plant_tomato_stage2.look: a growing TOMATO plant: a leafy green bush with small round UNRIPE GREEN tomatoes and a couple of tiny yellow blossoms. Fruit clearly green/unripe.

plant_tomato_stage3.look: a mature TOMATO plant ready to harvest: a lush leafy green bush heavy with several round ripe RED TOMATOES. Clearly ripe red fruit.

plant_corn_stage0.look: a tiny CORN SPROUT just emerging from dark tilled soil: a single thin grass-like green blade folded at the tip. Tiny, mostly bare soil visible.

plant_corn_stage1.look: a young knee-high CORN plant: a short green stalk with a few long arching young leaves, NO cobs, NO tassel. Clearly juvenile corn.

plant_corn_stage2.look: a tall growing CORN stalk with long arching leaves and a pale TASSEL forming at the top, but NO cobs yet. Tall and slender.

plant_corn_stage3.look: a mature CORN / maize plant ready to harvest: an upright green stalk with long arching leaves and TWO plump yellow CORN COBS with visible kernels. Clearly corn.

plant_wheat_stage0.look: tiny WHEAT SPROUTS just emerging from dark tilled soil: a few thin bright-green grass blades in a small clump. Tiny, mostly bare soil visible.

plant_wheat_stage1.look: young green WHEAT: a denser clump of upright GREEN grass-like stalks, taller, still fully green with no seed heads.

plant_wheat_stage2.look: ripe golden WHEAT ready to harvest: several upright tan-GOLDEN stalks topped with bushy seed heads, dry straw colour. Clearly wheat.
